actual_scope: Exact paid right-vector costs for every determinant-zero two-role target over K[t], over any field K.
scope_change_reason: This is an algebraic side result prompted by the singular-target gap in ToikY #4334, rather than a proof-assistant binding of the selected construction.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the restricted right-vector coefficient alphabet. It separates reachable singular polynomial endpoints from the unbounded invertible family; native coefficient preparation, access, restoration and the complete supplier bill remain unknown.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified original classification and package it; no further construction search.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-field classification; verify.py independently enumerates 24066 determinant-zero polynomial matrices, checks the one/two-factor boundaries and constructs every three-factor word. Thirty-five enumerated control groups distinguish sharp and boundary cases.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
